description:
Cast Gray Merchant by paying {5}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least four life and you to gain life equal to the life you gained this way.
Activate Ashnod's Altar six times by sacrificing Gray Merchant and five Thrulls, adding twelve {C}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {2} and two life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
